core.title: White Porcelain Knobs with Spindle, Nostalgic Warehouse

text.description_html:
Grandeur/Nostalgic Warehouse White Porcelain Knobs with Spindle

For new installations or restoration replacement white porcelain door knobs with spindle.

Nostalgic Warehouse's high quality, forged brass doorknobs are not to be confused with cast imitations. All of their doorknobs are mounted on solid, forged brass bases, not brass plated. If you are restoring a historic building, their doorknobs may fit right into your existing backplates. Bases available in 6 different finish choices.

Features of Nostalgic Warehouse White Porcelain Knob with Spindle

  • Two (2) Steel, Allen-head Set Screws
  • Two (2) White Porcelain Knobs
  • Spindle Length: 3-7/8"
  • Spindle Diameter: Square, 3/8-20 threaded ends
  • Base Diameter: Approximately 16mm
  • Ferrule: Approximately 15mm
  • Porcelain Knob Diameter: 2.25"
  • Porcelain Knob Projection: 1.94"
  • Three Year Finish Warranty
  • Available Finishes: 6
  • Mounting Base Material: Solid Brass
  • Knob Material: White Porcelain
  • Porcelain Knob Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold as a set: 2 Porcelain Knobs with set screws and 1 spindle
